proposals.name: Rail-anchored command switcher (org in the sidebar header, sub-scopes as crumbs, one cmdk popover for all three)
proposals.thesis: Optimises for a developer who changes org/project many times a day: every scope is reachable in two keystrokes from anywhere (chord, then type-to-filter), recents sit at the top, the same searchable popover serves 2 orgs or 2,000 (staff), and the current scope is always legible in the URL, the sidebar header and the action bar.
proposals.trigger: EXPANDED (240px): the shadcn sidebar-07 TeamSwitcher shape — a `SidebarMenuButton size="lg"` (48px row, 8px padding) in `SidebarHeader`, rendered with `render={<PopoverTrigger />}` (v4 Base UI style). Left: 32px `rounded-md` org avatar (logo, else two-letter initials on a deterministic hue from the slug). Middle: two truncated lines — line 1 org name 14px/500 (`text-sm font-medium truncate`, ~176px available), line 2 12px muted role from the session claim ("Owner", "Admin", "Member", "Viewer") or, for staff viewing a non-member org, an amber "Staff view" with an Eye icon. Right: `ChevronsUpDown` 16px. If pending invitations > 0 a 16px count badge (`Badge` destructive, min-w-4) sits on the avatar's top-right corner. Accessible name is set on the button, not inferred: `aria-label="Acme Corp, Owner. Switch organization"` plus `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded`. While memberships load the slot renders `SidebarMenuSkeleton showIcon` at the same 48px height so the header never shifts. RAIL (48px, `collapsible="icon"`): the same button collapses to `size-8 p-0` showing only the 32px avatar (count badge kept, clipped to the avatar), with `tooltip="Acme Corp · Owner"` (shadcn's right-side `TooltipContent`, only when `state === "collapsed"` and not mobile); staff view adds a 2px amber `ring-2 ring-amber-500` around the avatar; the tooltip is suppressed while the popover is open so two right-anchored surfaces never stack. Single-org users with no invitations and no create capability get the identity only: same 48px row, no chevron, no popover, `role` removed (it is a label, not a control).
proposals.menu: A shadcn `Popover` (not `DropdownMenu` — menus cannot hold a search input) containing a shadcn `Command` (cmdk v1). Width 288px (`w-72`), `align="start"`, `side="bottom"` when expanded and `side="right" sideOffset={8}` from the rail; `max-h-[70vh]`, list capped at 320px with its own scroll. Top to bottom: (1) HEADER ROW, 40px: 24px avatar of the current org, name, a `Badge variant="outline"` with the role ("Owner") — this is the one place role is stated once; a small `Settings` icon button on the right (`Organization settings`, only for owner/admin) — this row is outside the listbox so it never steals arrow-key focus. (2) `CommandInput` autofocused, placeholder "Switch organization… (O then O)", role=combobox with `aria-activedescendant`; the current org is the first highlighted item so Enter with an empty query is a no-op and screen readers hear the current org first. (3) `CommandGroup heading="Recent"` — up to 3 orgs, most-recent first, stored per user+console (`localStorage: latchkey.recentOrgs.<userId>.<console>`, pruned on every memberships refetch); each `CommandItem` is 32px: 20px avatar, name (`line-clamp-1`), right-aligned 12px muted role, a trailing `Check` on the current org (`aria-selected` + `data-current`), and a `CommandShortcut` "O 1" / "O 2" / "O 3". (4) `CommandGroup heading="Your organizations"` — the remaining memberships alphabetically, same row anatomy minus shortcuts; suspended/inactive memberships sink to the bottom with an `Info` icon + tooltip "Suspended by owner" (Sentry's active/inactive partition). Above 50 memberships the group is virtualised (`@tanstack/react-virtual`, fixed 32px rows) and `Command shouldFilter={false}` hands filtering to the server (150ms debounce); `aria-setsize`/`aria-posinset` on rows. (5) `CommandGroup heading="Invitations (n)"` — one item per pending invitation: 20px avatar, org name, secondary "Invited by jane@acme.com as Admin"; selecting navigates to `/invitations/:id` where Accept/Decline are real buttons on a page (interactive children are not allowed inside listbox items). Hidden when n = 0. (6) STAFF ONLY `CommandGroup heading="Platform"`: "Browse all organizations…" (→ `/platform/orgs`), and, once the query is ≥2 characters, server results for non-member orgs rendered with an Eye icon and a 12px "Staff" chip so they are never confused with memberships. (7) `CommandSeparator` then a footer `CommandGroup`: "Create organization" (`Plus`, only when the session's `capabilities` include `org:create`) and, for staff, "Platform console" (`ShieldCheck`). `CommandEmpty`: "No organizations match “<query>”" for a filtered-empty state; a distinct "Couldn't load organizations — Retry" item on fetch failure; `Command.Loading` spinner after 1s. Sign-out and personal settings are NOT here — they stay in `NavUser` at the sidebar footer. Selecting an org: server-side switch first (POST `/api/session/org`), then client-navigate; if the current route is declared `scope: "org"` in its route meta the path is rewritten in place (`/o/acme/…` → `/o/globex/…`), otherwise land on the org home; react-query cache is cleared for every key prefixed with the old org; a single polite live-region announcement "Switched to Globex". Entering or leaving staff view does a full reload so no cross-tenant data can survive in memory.
proposals.scopes: ORG lives in the sidebar header (trigger above) and in the URL as the first path segment after the console root: `/o/:orgSlug/...` for all three consoles; `/o/~/...` is the deep-link placeholder that resolves to the user's last-visited org (Vercel `~`, Cloudflare `:account`), then the account-level default org, then the first membership. PROJECT / TEAM-SERVICE / TENANT and ENVIRONMENT live in the sticky page action bar as switchable crumbs, left of the page breadcrumbs, using the same cmdk popover component in a compact variant: `Button variant="ghost" size="sm"` (28px high) per crumb, each with its own label, `ChevronDown` 12px, and its own Recent / All / Create groups. Tripline: `Acme` (plain link to `/o/acme`) ` / ` `[api-gateway ▾]` ` / ` `[production ▾]` — URL `/o/acme/p/api-gateway/e/production/issues`; the environment crumb is colour-coded (production = amber text with a 6px dot, staging = blue, dev = neutral) and switching project or environment preserves the current page ("projects as filters"). Runsheet: `Acme / [payments-team ▾]` — `/o/acme/t/payments/runbooks`. Latchkey admin: `Acme / [tenant: eu-prod ▾]` — `/o/acme/tenants/eu-prod/users`, tenant crumb also carries the environment tag badge (Prod/Staging) as Google Cloud does. Sub-scope crumbs are hidden on routes without that scope (org settings, billing). Below 768px the crumbs collapse into one compound `Acme / api-gateway / production ▾` button opening a `Sheet` with three stacked pickers. The org name in the action bar is a link, not a switcher, so the shell has exactly one org control. All API calls carry the org slug in the path; nothing depends on a server-side "current org" except the `/o/~` redirect.
proposals.staff: Staff is a claim on the latchkey session (`roles: ["platform:staff"]`), not a membership, so staff see two things members do not: a "Platform" group in the switcher (browse-all + cross-org server search) and a full-page directory at `/platform/orgs` — a `DataTable` with search (name, slug, owner email), status filter, a `Recent` chip row (last 5 from localStorage), and a grey "Current" badge on the row of the org they are already in; clicking a row opens `/o/:slug` exactly like a member. Opening an org you do not belong to puts the shell into STAFF VIEW, read-only by default: (a) sidebar header second line becomes amber "Staff view · not a member" with an Eye icon; in the 48px rail the avatar gets a 2px amber ring and the tooltip says "Acme Corp · Staff view"; (b) a 32px amber band (`bg-amber-50 border-b border-amber-300`, dark: `bg-amber-950/40`) is inserted between the action bar and page content, spanning the content area only, reading "Viewing Acme Corp as platform staff — read-only  [Elevate…] [Exit]"; it is not dismissible and not draggable (Clerk's FAB is the failure mode to avoid); (c) `document.title` is prefixed "[Staff] ", and the `html` element gets `data-staff-view` so any console can style destructive buttons disabled. "Elevate…" opens a `Dialog` requiring a reason (min 10 chars) and a duration (`15m / 1h / 4h`, default 1h), issues a time-boxed `act` claim, writes an audit event visible to that org's owners under Settings > Access log, and changes the band to "Elevated in Acme Corp · 58 min left · reason: INC-4412  [Exit]"; write actions become available only under that claim. "Exit" (also `Esc` while the band is focused, and the "Exit staff view" item that replaces "Organization settings" in the switcher header) returns to `/platform/orgs` and full-reloads. If a staff member is also a genuine member of the org, membership wins and no band is shown.
proposals.keyboard: Global chords (Linear-style, ignored when focus is in an editable element, contenteditable, or an open dialog): `O` then `O` opens the org switcher; `O` then `P` (tripline project / runsheet team / latchkey tenant) and `O` then `E` (environment) open the corresponding crumb picker even when the crumbs are visually collapsed; `O` then `1`–`3` switches straight to recent org 1–3 with no popup (shown as `CommandShortcut` on those rows and in the trigger tooltip). No Mod+1–9 (browser tab shortcuts). `Mod+K` palette carries "Switch organization…", "Switch project…", "Switch environment…" entries that open the same pickers with the typed query carried over. `Mod+B` toggles the sidebar (shadcn default); the switcher works identically from the rail. Focus behaviour on the trigger: `Enter`, `Space`, `ArrowDown` open the popover and place focus in the `CommandInput` with the current org highlighted; typing filters immediately; `ArrowUp/Down` move the active descendant across groups (headings are skipped); `Home/End` jump; `Enter` selects; `Esc` closes and returns focus to the trigger (`onCloseAutoFocus`); `Tab` from the input moves to the header settings button then the footer items, `Shift+Tab` back; `Backspace` on an empty query does nothing (it does not close). On selection focus lands on the page's `h1` after navigation so the announcement "Switched to Globex" (single `aria-live="polite"` status region owned by the shell) is followed by the new page heading. In the staff band, `Tab` reaches Elevate then Exit; `Esc` on the band triggers Exit. Tooltips open on focus without delay (Radix/Base UI behaviour) and close on Enter/Space.
proposals.edge_cases: ONE ORG (no invitations, no create capability): the header shows identity only — avatar, name, role — with no chevron and no popover; chords are unregistered; the account menu in `NavUser` still exposes "Invitations" and "Create organization" (when allowed) so the path to a second org is not hidden. ZERO ORGS: no sidebar nav at all; the shell renders a full-page `/welcome` gate with three sections — pending invitations as cards with real Accept/Decline buttons, "Create an organization" (if `org:create`), otherwise "Ask an owner to invite you with <email>" with a copy button; staff with zero memberships are sent to `/platform/orgs` instead. 50+ ORGS: the popover shows Recent + the first 8 alphabetical rows and a muted "Type to search 212 organizations" hint until the query is ≥1 character; rows are virtualised at 32px; filtering is server-side with `Command shouldFilter={false}`; a `Combobox.Status`-style `aria-live` line reports "12 results"; the "Your organizations" heading shows the total count. PENDING INVITATIONS: count badge on the avatar in both widths; "Invitations (n)" group in the popover; each item navigates to `/invitations/:id`; accepting there invalidates memberships, adds the org to recents and lands in it; an invite link opened from email while signed in deep-links straight to `/invitations/:id` rather than the homepage; an invitation to an org the user already belongs to is auto-consumed. LONG NAMES: expanded trigger truncates with `title` and the full name in the tooltip; popover rows `line-clamp-2` at 12px leading-tight (row grows to 44px); crumbs truncate at 160px each and the action bar drops the org link first when width is short; initials avatars use the first letters of the first two words to reduce collisions. LOADING: skeleton in the header slot (same 48px) until session memberships resolve; popover shows nothing for the first 1s then `Command.Loading` with one live announcement "Loading organizations"; fetch failure renders "Couldn't load organizations — Retry" as a selectable item; during an in-flight switch the trigger gets `aria-busy` and the avatar a spinner overlay, and the old page stays mounted until the new org's bootstrap query resolves. NOT A MEMBER (URL names an org the user left): a 403 page "You no longer have access to acme" with the switcher still functional in the header and a "Go to your organizations" button; no silent fallback to the first org. SUSPENDED ORG: listed but greyed with an info tooltip, selectable only by owners (who land on the billing page).
risks: Single-key chords (O then O / P / E) require a reliable focus guard; any console page that forgets to mark a custom editable widget (code editors, terminals in runsheet) will eat the shortcut or fire it while typing — ship the guard in the shell hotkey hook and test it against CodeMirror/Monaco.

Recents live in localStorage per device, so a developer on two machines sees different orderings and different O-1/O-2 targets; moving recents server-side (per user+console) fixes this at the cost of a write per switch.
Three switchable crumbs plus page breadcrumbs crowd the sticky action bar on narrow laptops; the <768px collapse rule must be tested at 1024–1280px too, or the action bar's own actions will wrap.

The route-meta rule (keep path when org-scoped, otherwise land on org home) is easy to get wrong per console; a route declared org-scoped that actually depends on a project will 404 after a switch — require the meta on every route and lint for it.

Staff view relies on a claim and a full-page reload for isolation; if any console caches org data outside react-query (zustand, module singletons) the reload is the only thing preventing cross-tenant leakage — audit those stores.

cmdk inside a Popover anchored to a 48px rail produces a popup that can overlap the rail's tooltips and, on mobile, has no room — the Sheet fallback below 768px must also apply to the org switcher, not only to the crumbs.

Role is shown only on the second line and in the popover header, so in the rail the user cannot tell they are a Viewer until an action is disabled; consoles must render disabled-with-reason tooltips rather than hiding actions.

Server-side search for staff and for 50+ memberships introduces a race between typed queries and returned pages; abort stale requests and key results by query or the list will flicker to an older result set.

Invitation acceptance deep-links assume a single latchkey session across all three consoles; if consoles are on different origins the /invitations/:id redirect chain needs an explicit return-to parameter.

proposals.name: Anchor: rooted org switcher, scope-chain action bar, unmistakable staff lane
proposals.thesis: Optimise for never being confused about where you are: the org and your role are always on screen in the sidebar header, the sub-scope (project/env, team/service, tenant) is always on screen as switchable breadcrumbs in the action bar, every scope is in the URL path, and platform staff viewing an org they do not belong to get a distinct amber lane that cannot be mistaken for membership and cannot write without a time-boxed, reasoned elevation.
proposals.trigger: EXPANDED (240px sidebar): SidebarHeader contains one shadcn SidebarMenuButton size="lg" (48px tall, 8px padding, rounded-md), the shadcn sidebar-07 TeamSwitcher shape. Left: 32x32 org avatar (rounded-md; logo, else two-letter initials on a deterministic hue derived from the org id so 'Acme' and 'Apex' never share a colour). Middle, two truncated lines: line 1 org name (text-sm font-medium, 168px max), line 2 the role for THIS org as plain text-xs text-muted-foreground ('Owner' / 'Admin' / 'Member' / 'Viewer'). Right: ChevronsUpDown 16px (omitted when the user has exactly one org and no invitations). A pending-invitation count renders as a 16px badge (bg-primary, text-[10px]) overlapping the avatar's top-right corner. Staff view-as state: the whole button gets bg-amber-100/dark:bg-amber-950 with a 2px amber ring, line 2 becomes 'Staff view · not a member' (amber-700), avatar gets an Eye 12px overlay. Button attributes: type=button, aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded, aria-controls=org-switcher, aria-label="Organisation: Acme Corp. Your role: Owner. 2 pending invitations. Switch organisation" (label is rebuilt from data so it is identical in both sidebar states). RAIL (48px, collapsible="icon"): the same button collapses to size-8 p-0 (shadcn's lg rule) so only the 32px avatar shows; the invite badge shrinks to an 8px dot on the avatar corner; the staff ring stays. The `tooltip` prop renders TooltipContent side="right" (only when state==="collapsed" and not mobile) reading 'Acme Corp · Owner' plus the shortcut hint 'G then O'; the tooltip closes on Enter/Space and is suppressed while the popover is open so the two right-anchored popups never stack. Below the header in both states sits the normal SidebarContent; identity (user avatar, email, account settings, sign-out) lives only in the footer NavUser, never in the org switcher.
proposals.menu: Opens a shadcn Popover (not DropdownMenu, because invitations need navigation rows and staff need search) side="bottom" align="start" in the expanded sidebar with width = trigger width (w-(--radix-popover-trigger-width), i.e. 224px content), and side="right" align="start" sideOffset=8 w-80 (320px) when in the rail. Inside: a Command (cmdk) root; PopoverContent has role="dialog" aria-label="Switch organisation"; the list is role="listbox" with aria-activedescendant on the input, rows are role="option" aria-selected. Top to bottom: (1) HEADER, 56px, non-interactive: 32px avatar, org name (font-medium, truncate), second line role as a shadcn Badge variant="secondary" ('Owner'), trailing Check 16px; in staff view-as the header is amber with Badge variant="outline" 'Staff view'. (2) CommandInput, 36px, placeholder 'Find organisation…', autofocus; rendered only when memberships + invitations > 5 or the user is platform staff (otherwise focus goes to the listbox root and cmdk arrow/typeahead still work). (3) Group 'Invitations (n)' — only when n > 0: each row 40px: 20px avatar, org name, secondary text 'Invited as Admin', trailing ArrowRight; it is ONE option that navigates to /invitations/:id (Accept/Decline are real buttons on that page, not menu children). (4) Group 'Recent' — only when > 8 orgs: last 5 visited (localStorage key latchkey.recentOrgs.<userId>, pruned on load against current memberships). (5) Group 'Your organisations': one row per active membership, sorted by name, current org pinned first with Check and aria-selected=true; each row 36px: 20px avatar, name (truncate), role in text-xs text-muted-foreground right-aligned, and for the first nine a kbd hint '1'…'9'. Memberships whose org is suspended/deactivated go in a separate group 'Inactive', dimmed, with an Info icon whose tooltip carries the status name; they are not selectable. (6) Group 'Platform' — platform staff only: 'All organisations' (Building2 icon, kbd 'A') navigates to /platform/orgs, a full-page directory (search by name/slug/domain, 'Current' badge on the row you are in, Recent and Starred filters, 'View as staff' button per row, server-side paging). While staff type in the input, results beyond their memberships are fetched from GET /api/platform/orgs?q= and rendered in this group with an Eye icon and secondary text 'Staff view' instead of a role, so a staff member can never confuse 'org I belong to' with 'org I can look into'. (7) Footer: Separator, then 'Create organisation' (Plus icon) rendered only when the session's capabilities include org:create; then, for single-org users with no invitations, the menu still shows 'Invitations' (0) greyed and 'Create organisation' so a path to a second org is never hidden. (8) Empty/error rows: CommandEmpty 'No organisations match' (for search), a distinct 'Couldn't load organisations — Retry' row (with a real button) on fetch failure, and Command.Loading skeleton rows (3 × 36px) with aria-busy while the list is fetched on first open; the popover never collapses to zero height. Selecting an org: POST /api/session/org {org} first (aborts and shows an inline error if refused), then client-navigate to /o/:slug (org home) unless the current route is marked orgOnly in the route table, in which case the same path is rewritten with the new slug; all org-keyed queries are removed from the query cache, per-console sub-scope stores (project/env, team/service, tenant) are reset, and one aria-live="polite" region announces 'Switched to Acme Corp' once.
proposals.scopes: ORG lives in the sidebar header trigger and as the first path segment: /o/:orgSlug/... in all three consoles. It is never session-only, so links are shareable and two tabs can hold two orgs; the session's last-org value is used solely to decide where / redirects (account-level default org set in account settings, overridden per console by last-visited stored server-side per user+console, localStorage fallback; the default is auto-reassigned when membership is removed). A URL naming an org the user is not a member of renders a dedicated 403 page 'You are not a member of Acme Corp' with the switcher still available; staff additionally see a 'View as staff' button there. SUB-SCOPE lives in the sticky page action bar as switchable breadcrumb crumbs, left-aligned, 32px tall, each crumb = a Link (navigates to that scope's home) + a 24px chevron button (aria-haspopup="dialog", opens its own Popover+Command with search, current item checked, 'Create …' footer gated by role): tripline /o/:org/p/:project/e/:env/issues — crumbs 'Org name / Project / Environment' where the environment crumb carries a 8px colour dot (production = amber-500 with text 'production', staging = sky, dev = neutral) and the crumb reads text-amber-700 when production is selected; runsheet /o/:org/t/:team/... — crumbs 'Org / Team or service'; latchkey admin /o/:org/tenants/:tenant/... — crumbs 'Org / Tenant', and org-level pages (Members, Roles, Billing) show only the org crumb. The sidebar header is thus the root of the crumb chain: the org name appears both in the header and as crumb 1, deliberately, because the header disappears in the 48px rail. Sub-scope pickers and the org switcher are the same component (ScopePicker) with different data sources, so keyboard and ARIA behaviour is identical everywhere. Per-console last-visited sub-scope is remembered per org (server-side user+console+org, mirroring Sentry's per-org page-filter persistence) so switching back to an org restores its project/team/tenant; switching org never carries a sub-scope across. Deep links without a sub-scope (/o/:org/p/~/issues, alert emails, runbook links) resolve the placeholder to the remembered sub-scope or, if none, land on a chooser page.
proposals.staff: Platform staff hold a `platform_staff: true` claim in the latchkey session but NO implicit membership: their switcher lists only orgs they belong to under 'Your organisations', plus the 'Platform' group ('All organisations' page + server-side search results marked 'Staff view'). Entering an org they are not a member of (from the directory row, the search result, or the 'View as staff' button on the 403 page) opens a shadcn Dialog 'View Acme Corp as staff' with a required Reason textarea (min 10 chars) and a Duration select (30 min / 1 h / 4 h, default 1 h); confirming calls POST /api/platform/view-as {org, reason, ttl}, which mints a session with an `act: {sub: staffUserId, org, reason, exp}` claim, writes an audit event visible to that org's owners under Settings > Access log, and navigates to /o/:slug. The view-as state is rendered from the `act` claim so all three consoles show identical chrome: (a) the sidebar-header trigger goes amber with second line 'Staff view · not a member' and an Eye overlay, and in the 48px rail the avatar keeps the 2px amber ring; (b) a 32px sticky strip is inserted directly above the page action bar, full content width, bg-amber-100/dark:bg-amber-950 with border-b border-amber-300, text 'Viewing Acme Corp as latchkey staff — read-only · expires in 47 min', role="status", with two buttons on the right: 'Elevate' and 'Exit'; (c) the root element gets data-view-as="staff" and a 3px amber top border on the sidebar so it is visible even when the content scrolls; (d) document.title is prefixed '[Staff] '. Default view-as is read-only: every mutating control renders disabled with a tooltip 'Read-only in staff view — elevate to change', and the API rejects writes without elevation. 'Elevate' opens a second Dialog requiring re-authentication via latchkey (passwordless magic-link/passkey re-prompt), a reason, and a duration capped at 1 h; while elevated the strip turns bg-red-100 with text 'Elevated · can modify Acme Corp · 52 min left' and a 'Drop elevation' button, and the org's owners receive a notification. 'Exit' (also Esc from the strip, and the switcher's header row 'Exit staff view') clears the `act` claim and returns to /platform/orgs; expiry does the same automatically with a toast. Staff who ARE members of an org see it as any member would, with their real role and no amber chrome, so the amber lane always means exactly 'not a member'.
proposals.keyboard: Open: the trigger is a native button — Enter, Space and ArrowDown open the popover; a global chord 'G then O' (shown in the rail tooltip and in the trigger's title) opens it from anywhere, and the ⌘/Ctrl+K command palette lists 'Switch organisation…' plus 'Switch to <org>' entries that filter by typing; no positional ⌘/Ctrl+1..9 globally because browsers own those, but INSIDE the open popover digits 1–9 select the correspondingly numbered org row and 'A' (staff) jumps to All organisations. Inside: when the CommandInput is rendered, focus lands in the input and ArrowUp/ArrowDown move aria-activedescendant through options (cmdk), Home/End jump, typing filters, Enter selects, Tab is trapped within the popover (input → list → footer actions → back); when no input is rendered, focus lands on the current (checked) org option so the first announcement a screen-reader user hears is the org they are already in, and first-letter typeahead works. Close: Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger (Popover onCloseAutoFocus), as does selecting an org (focus returns to the trigger, then the route change moves focus to the new page's h1 per the shell's route-focus rule). Sub-scope crumb pickers use the same component and same keys, plus 'G then P' (project/team/tenant) and 'G then E' (environment) chords in tripline. Sidebar collapse stays on shadcn's ⌘/Ctrl+B; a collapsed rail still exposes the full aria-label so nothing depends on the tooltip. All shortcuts are disabled while a text field or the view-as dialog is focused, and the chord hints are hidden (and the chevron removed) for users with exactly one org.
proposals.edge_cases: ZERO ORGS: the shell does not render the sidebar at all; the user lands on /welcome, a full page listing pending invitations as cards with real Accept/Decline buttons, a 'Create organisation' card if org:create is allowed, otherwise copy 'Ask an organisation admin to invite you with <email>'; staff with zero memberships land on /platform/orgs instead. ONE ORG: the trigger shows avatar, name and role but no chevron and no chord hint; clicking still opens a reduced popover (header, 'Invitations (0)' greyed, 'Create organisation' if allowed) so the path to a second org is discoverable; aria-haspopup remains so the button is honest. 50+ ORGS / STAFF: CommandInput always shown, list virtualised above 100 rows (fixed 36px rows, aria-setsize/aria-posinset set manually), 'Recent' group at the top, staff results fetched server-side with a 250 ms debounce and a Command.Loading row, and the full-page /platform/orgs directory (search, Recent, Starred stored server-side per user, 'Current' badge, paging) for anything the popover cannot comfortably hold. PENDING INVITATIONS: count badge on the trigger avatar in both sidebar states; 'Invitations (n)' group is the first group in the popover; each is a single navigating option to /invitations/:id; accepting from that page lands in the new org's home with a toast; an invite link opened from email while signed in deep-links straight to /invitations/:id rather than the homepage; declined/expired invites disappear from the badge count within the same session (query invalidated on return). LONG NAMES: name lines truncate with CSS and carry the full name in title=; initials avatars use the first letters of the first two words; the popover max-width is 320px in the rail and equals the sidebar width when expanded, so nothing overflows the shell; the action-bar crumbs collapse middle crumbs into an ellipsis DropdownMenu below 768px. LOADING: while the session bootstraps the header renders SidebarMenuSkeleton showIcon (32px circle + two lines of 12px) at the exact 48px height so there is no layout shift; the trigger is disabled until memberships arrive; opening the popover before the invitation query resolves shows the 'Invitations' group as one skeleton row with aria-busy; a fetch failure shows the Retry row rather than an empty list; switching shows a 2px indeterminate Progress bar under the action bar and announces once when done. SUSPENDED ORG: listed in the 'Inactive' group, not selectable, with a tooltip explaining the status; visiting its URL renders a full-page 'Acme Corp is suspended' state with the switcher intact. NOT A MEMBER URL: 403 page as described under scopes, never a silent fallback to the first org. MOBILE (<768px): the sidebar becomes a Sheet and the switcher opens as a bottom Drawer with the same content, tooltips disabled, invite badge preserved.
risks: Org name appears twice on wide screens (sidebar header and action-bar crumb 1); intentional for the rail case but may read as redundant — mitigate by making crumb 1 muted and only the sub-scope crumbs interactive-looking when the sidebar is expanded.

Popover+Command is heavier than the shadcn DropdownMenu that sidebar-07 ships; the ≤5-org path without an input relies on cmdk keyboard handling on the root and must be tested with VoiceOver/NVDA so the current org is announced on open.

Staff search hits a platform-wide endpoint from inside the switcher; it needs strict rate limiting, audit logging of queries, and must never leak org existence to non-staff sessions (server checks the claim, not a client flag).

Read-only view-as depends on every console disabling mutations on the client AND the API rejecting writes without elevation; if one console forgets, staff could edit silently under the amber banner. Add a shared fetch wrapper that refuses non-GET without an elevation token when act is present.

Path-scoped org plus remembered sub-scope means the '~' placeholder resolver and the not-a-member 403 must exist in all three consoles before launch; until then deep links from alerts/runbooks may dead-end.

The 'G then O' chord and in-popover digit shortcuts are new to users; without the tooltip hint and a shortcuts page they will go unused, and digits clash if a future search input receives them — keep digits scoped to the no-input variant only.

Amber for staff view and amber for tripline production environment could be confused if both show at once; reserve the 3px sidebar top border and the sticky strip for staff state and keep environment colour to the crumb dot only.

proposals.name: Root Crumb: one sidebar-header org switcher, every other scope a URL filter chip in the action bar
proposals.thesis: One shell component (a searchable org picker in the sidebar header, backed by the session's membership list) and one route shape (/o/:org/... with sub-scopes as query params) serve tripline, runsheet and the latchkey console identically; project/environment, team/service and tenant are never switchers, only filters, and staff access is the same picker plus one audited view-as flag.
proposals.trigger: Expanded (240px): SidebarHeader > SidebarMenu > SidebarMenuItem > SidebarMenuButton size="lg" (h-12, full width, px-2). Left: 32px rounded-md avatar (org logo, else two-letter initials on a hue derived from org id). Middle, two truncated lines: line 1 org name 14px font-medium; line 2 12px text-muted-foreground with the normalised latchkey role ("Owner" / "Admin" / "Member" / "Viewer"), or "Staff view" in amber when acting via view-as. Right: ChevronsUpDown 16px, rendered only when orgs.length > 1 || invitations > 0 || canCreate || isStaff (so a one-org member sees identity, not a switch affordance). Pending invitations: 16px count Badge (destructive tone) overlapping the avatar's top-right corner. Staff view-as: ring-2 ring-amber-500 ring-offset-1 on the avatar. Button attributes: aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded, aria-label="Acme Corp, Admin. Open organisation switcher", aria-busy while the session loads; before load the slot renders SidebarMenuSkeleton showIcon (same 48px height, no layout shift). Collapsed 48px rail (collapsible="icon"): shadcn shrinks the button to size-8 p-0 so only the 32px avatar (with badge and staff ring) survives; text lines and chevron hidden; `tooltip` prop supplies right-side TooltipContent "Acme Corp · Admin" (or "· Staff view"), shown only when state==="collapsed" and not mobile; tooltip is closed on open and disabled while the popover is open so two right-anchored popups never stack. The org name is repeated as the root breadcrumb in the sticky action bar, so it stays visible in the rail without a second switcher.
proposals.menu:
Component: shadcn Popover + Command (cmdk), never DropdownMenu, so search, invitations and the staff directory share one keyboard model (input + role=listbox/option) at every org count. PopoverContent side="right" align="start" sideOffset={4} (side="bottom" on mobile), w-72 (288px) in both sidebar states, p-0, max-h-[420px]. Top to bottom:
1. CommandInput, autofocused, placeholder "Find organisation…", 36px tall, border-b; trailing CommandShortcut "g o". Always present (it is the typeahead even for 2 orgs). For non-staff it filters client-side over the memberships embedded in the /session payload (cap 500, no fetch on open). For staff, shouldFilter={false}: memberships filter locally and, after 200ms debounce on 2+ chars, a server query GET /staff/orgs?q= adds the "All organisations" group; CommandLoading shows a 16px spinner row and a polite live region "Searching…".
2. CommandList max-h-[320px] (ScrollArea):
   - CommandGroup heading="Your organisations": one CommandItem per membership, ordered current first, then up to 3 recents (localStorage `orgs.recent.<userId>`, pruned when membership disappears), then alphabetical. Row 36px: 24px avatar, name truncate, role in 12px text-muted-foreground right-aligned, trailing Check 16px on the current org (aria-selected=true, the row cmdk announces first). Suspended/inactive membership: item disabled with Badge variant="outline" "Suspended" and title text explaining status.
   - CommandGroup heading="Invitations (n)" only when n > 0: row shows 24px avatar, org name, "Invited as Member" secondary; select navigates to /invitations/:id (full page with Accept / Decline buttons, since options cannot contain buttons).
   - CommandGroup heading="All organisations" (staff only, appears with server results): rows show name, slug and "Not a member" secondary; selecting opens the view-as dialog (see staff).
   - CommandEmpty: "No organisations match"; with zero memberships and no query: "You are not a member of any organisation" (the sidebar is not rendered in that state anyway, see edge cases).
3. CommandSeparator.
4. CommandGroup (no heading, actions): "Create organisation" with Plus icon, rendered only when the session carries capability org:create (navigates to /orgs/new, a page not a modal, because latchkey creation has more than one field); "All organisations…" with Building2 icon, staff only, navigates to /staff/orgs (full-page directory: search, Current badge on the active row, recents, per-row "View as staff").
Nothing about the person lives here: name, email, account settings, invitations page link and Sign out stay in the sidebar footer NavUser (shadcn nav-user), so the org menu never exceeds one screen.
proposals.scopes: Org: the sidebar header trigger and the first path segment, /o/:orgSlug/<console page>. The URL is the source of truth; the session's last-visited org (stored server-side per user + console, localStorage fallback) only decides where "/" redirects; a URL for an org the user is not in renders a 403-styled "No access to this organisation" page with the switcher still mounted (staff additionally get a "View as staff" button there). Sub-scopes (tripline project + environment, runsheet team/service, latchkey tenant): never in the sidebar. They are filter chips in the sticky page action bar, right of the breadcrumbs: each chip is the same ScopePicker component as the org switcher (Popover + Command, h-8, Badge-like outline button with 12px label "Project: api" / "Env: production" / "Team: payments" / "Tenant: acme-eu", ChevronDown 14px) and reads/writes one query param: ?project=api&env=prod, ?team=payments&service=checkout, ?tenant=acme-eu. Absent param = the console's default ("all" or "mine"); the resolved value is persisted per org and console in localStorage `scope.<console>.<org>` and, on entering a route without params, written back into the URL with history.replace so every copied link is explicit. Environment values carry a colour token (production = warning tone) on the chip and in rows. Breadcrumbs: root crumb is the org name linking to /o/:org (a link, not a switcher), then page crumbs; scope chips are visually separated from crumbs by a 1px divider so they read as scope, not search filters. Switching org: if the current route is marked scope:"org" in the console's route table the path is rewritten in place with the new slug and all sub-scope params dropped; otherwise the shell lands on /o/:newSlug. Client navigation, not a reload: the shell removes every query whose key contains the old slug, resets the scope chips, and fires one polite live-region message "Switched to Acme Corp", then moves focus to the page h1.
proposals.staff: latchkey platform staff carry roles:["platform:staff"] in the session. They use the same switcher: their real memberships appear as normal rows; typing in the CommandInput also searches the whole directory (server, debounced) into an "All organisations" group, and "All organisations…" opens the /staff/orgs directory page for browsing (search, recents, Current badge, per-row "View as staff"). Selecting an org they are not a member of opens a shadcn Dialog "View Acme Corp as staff" with a required Reason textarea and a fixed 60-minute duration; on confirm the server records the reason (audit event org.staff_view.started) and sets a view-as flag on the session ({act: {staff: true, org: "acme", exp}}), then the shell navigates to /o/acme. While the flag is active every console renders the same chrome from the claim: amber ring on the trigger avatar (expanded and 48px rail), second line "Staff view · read-only" (or the effective role granted), the org row in the list shows "Staff" instead of a role, body gets data-staff-view="true", and the action bar shows a persistent amber Badge left of the breadcrumbs: "Viewing as staff · 47 min left · Exit" where Exit is a real button (also reachable as the first item in the org menu's actions group while acting). Exit or expiry clears the flag server-side and returns to /staff/orgs; an expired flag mid-page shows the 403 page with "View as staff" again. Staff who are genuine members of an org get no elevation, no ring and their normal role. No global "see everything" toggle exists, so nobody is silently inside a tenant.
proposals.keyboard: Trigger: Tab reaches it (it is the first focusable in the sidebar); Enter, Space or ArrowDown open the popover and put focus in CommandInput; Radix/Base UI tooltip opens on Tab focus and closes on Enter/Space/Esc. Inside: type to filter; ArrowUp/ArrowDown move aria-activedescendant through role=option rows (current org first, so one ArrowDown reads the current context); Home/End jump; Enter selects (navigate); Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger (onCloseAutoFocus / finalFocus); Tab out closes. Global: chord "g" then "o" (750ms window, ignored when focus is in an input/textarea/contenteditable) opens the switcher from anywhere; shown in the trigger tooltip and as CommandShortcut in the input. No positional Cmd/Ctrl+1–9 because those are browser tab shortcuts. Cmd/Ctrl+B toggles the rail (shadcn default). Scope chips: each is a button with aria-haspopup="dialog" and the same inner keyboard model; consoles may register a chord ("g p", "g e", "g t") through the shell's shortcut registry. After a switch, focus moves to the new page's h1 and a single aria-live="polite" announcement fires; the trigger's aria-label updates to the new org and role.
proposals.edge_cases: Zero orgs: the shell renders no sidebar and no action bar, only a full-page /welcome: heading "You are not in any organisation yet", a list of pending invitations with real Accept / Decline buttons, "Create organisation" if org:create, otherwise copy "Ask an administrator to invite you"; staff with zero memberships land on /staff/orgs instead. One org: trigger shows identity (avatar, name, role) without the chevron unless invitations or create/staff apply; the popover still opens on Enter/ArrowDown and shows the single checked row plus any invitations and actions, so the path to a second org is never hidden. 50+ orgs: memberships are already in the session (cap 500) so the list opens instantly; recents (3) sit above the alphabetical remainder; the list scrolls inside max-h-[320px] and the input filters client-side; virtualisation is not needed below 500 rows; beyond that (staff directory) search is server-side and the directory page is the browsing surface. Pending invitations: count badge on the avatar in both sidebar states, "Invitations (n)" group in the menu, invitation emails deep-link to /invitations/:id which signs in via latchkey then accepts then redirects to /o/:slug; declined or expired invitations disappear from the group on the next session refresh. Long names: name truncates at about 150px in the trigger (title attribute and tooltip carry the full name), rows truncate the name and keep the role column fixed; initials avatars use the first letters of the first two words; slug shown as secondary text in staff results to disambiguate look-alikes. Loading: SidebarMenuSkeleton for the trigger and breadcrumb skeleton in the action bar until /session resolves (under 1s shows nothing else; over 1s the skeleton has one aria-busy group); if /session fails the trigger renders "Couldn't load organisations" with a Retry row in the popover. Suspended org: disabled row with "Suspended" badge; a direct URL shows a suspended page with the switcher mounted. Mobile (< 768px): the sidebar becomes a Sheet, the popover uses side="bottom" and the scope chips wrap under the breadcrumbs. Multiple tabs: because org is in the path, two tabs on two orgs never clobber each other; the staff view-as flag is per session so a second tab inherits the same acting state and the same amber chrome.
risks: Popover + Command (role=dialog with a listbox) instead of an APG menu button: screen readers announce a dialog and focus lands in the search input, so the current org is heard only after one ArrowDown; mitigated by putting the current org first and naming it in the trigger's aria-label, but it is not the pattern Sentry or shadcn sidebar-07 ship.

Sub-scopes as query params plus a per-org localStorage fallback can surprise users when a link without params resolves to their own remembered project/env; the history.replace write-back makes copied links explicit but adds one URL rewrite on every route entry that consoles must not treat as a navigation.

Staff view-as (reason dialog, server flag, 60-minute expiry, audit event) is extra server surface for a 'smallest shell' brief; it is the only model in the evidence that keeps an IdP auditable, but it must be built once in latchkey and read via the session claim by all three consoles.

Role is shown from latchkey's normalised owner/admin/member/viewer only; if tripline or runsheet later grow their own per-project or per-team roles, the trigger's second line will be wrong or missing and consoles will need a hook to override it.

Initials avatars collide (two 'Acme …' orgs in a 48px rail look identical); only the tooltip and aria-label disambiguate, and neither exists on touch, so the rail should auto-expand or show the root breadcrumb on narrow layouts.

shadcn v4 sits on Base UI while older recipes are Radix: the popover width variable (--anchor-width vs --radix-popover-trigger-width), finalFocus vs onCloseAutoFocus, and tooltip focus behaviour differ, so the switcher must be written against one primitive set and pinned.

Staff search merges two data sources (local memberships, server directory) in one Command with shouldFilter={false}; debounce, loading and empty states must be handled by hand, and a slow directory query can make the local results appear to lag.
Root breadcrumb duplicates the org name as a link, not a switcher; some users will click it expecting to switch (Supabase's crumbs do switch) and land on the org home instead.

judged.winner: Anchor: rooted org switcher, scope-chain action bar, unmistakable staff lane (Proposal 2)
judged.why: All three proposals converge on the same skeleton (shadcn sidebar-07 trigger in the SidebarHeader, Popover+Command instead of DropdownMenu, /o/:orgSlug paths, invitations as navigating options, a full-page /welcome zero state, amber staff chrome), so the decision turns on the three places they differ: (1) where sub-scopes live, (2) how platform staff enter a tenant, (3) how much keyboard/model variance the shell carries. Proposal 2 wins on (1) and (2). On sub-scopes, path segments for project / team-or-service / tenant match what those things are in runsheet and the latchkey console — containers with their own sub-navigation (a tenant has users, apps, policies; a team has runbooks) — and the evidence (Vercel's team/project path with the ~ placeholder, Cloudflare :account/:zone, Supabase org/project/branch crumbs) backs path-scoped containers; Proposal 3's query-param chips only fit filter-like scopes (Sentry's ?project=&environment=, where 'all' and multi-select are legal), which describes tripline's environment but not a latchkey tenant. On staff access, Proposal 2 is the only one that gates entry to a non-member org behind a reason + duration dialog (WorkOS impersonation, Okta support access, Entra PIM all require justification and a TTL), makes read-only the default, requires step-up for elevation, and keeps the rule 'amber means exactly not-a-member' — for an identity provider whose admin console lists PII, auditing the view and not just the write is the right bar; Proposal 1 lets staff browse any tenant with no recorded reason, and Proposal 3 has no elevation path at all. Proposal 2 also remembers the last sub-scope per org server-side (Sentry's per-org page-filter persistence) so returning to an org restores its project/tenant, and it specifies real 403 / suspended pages rather than silent fallbacks (the Sentry failure mode called out in the evidence). Its weaknesses — a conditional CommandInput that yields two keyboard models, digits-as-shortcuts inside the popover, a 224px popover in the expanded state that is too narrow for a role column, and no isolation reload on staff transitions — are exactly where Proposals 1 and 3 are stronger, so those parts are grafted in. Proposal 1's chord-heavy, recents-first design is the best pure-speed switcher but spends its complexity on O-then-1..3 positional shortcuts that shift as recents change and on a staff mode that is too permissive for latchkey; Proposal 3's 'smallest shell' is attractive but its history.replace write-back on every route entry and its single query-param model would force runsheet and latchkey to pretend containers are filters.
grafted: From Proposal 3: tripline's environment becomes a query-param filter chip (?env=production, default 'all') in the action bar rather than a path crumb — Vercel and Sentry both keep environment as an in-page filter because a third breadcrumb level does not fit; project stays a path segment.
From Proposal 3: memberships and invitation counts ship embedded in the /session payload (cap 500) so the popover opens instantly with no fetch; only staff directory search hits the server.

From Proposal 1: the CommandInput is always rendered (one keyboard model: input + aria-activedescendant listbox) instead of Proposal 2's 'only above 5 orgs' variant; in-popover digit shortcuts are dropped.

From Proposal 1: a fixed 288px (w-72) popover in both sidebar states instead of trigger-width (224px is too narrow for name + role column); side=bottom from the expanded header, side=right from the rail.
From Proposal 1: entering or leaving staff view-as does a full page reload so no cross-tenant data survives in react-query, zustand or module singletons (Grafana's abort-and-reload evidence).

From Proposal 1: every route declares scope meta ('org' | 'project' | 'team' | 'tenant'); switching org rewrites the path in place only for org-scoped routes and lands on the org home otherwise; lint requires the meta on every route.
From Proposal 1: the '~' placeholder (/o/~/…, /o/:org/p/~/…) resolves last-visited → account default → first membership, and is what alert emails and runbook links use.

From Proposal 1: '50+ orgs' behaviour — 'Type to search N organisations' hint until the query is non-empty, rows virtualised above 100 with aria-setsize/posinset, stale server searches aborted and results keyed by query.
From Proposal 1: the trigger gets aria-busy and a spinner overlay during an in-flight switch and the old page stays mounted until the new org's bootstrap query resolves.
From Proposal 3: staff search results show the slug as secondary text (disambiguates look-alike names) and 'Exit staff view' is the first item in the actions group while acting.
From Proposal 3: `data-staff-view` on <html> plus the view-as flag being per session, so a second tab inherits the same amber chrome.

From Proposal 3: the environment chip is visually separated from the breadcrumb crumbs by a 1px divider so it reads as scope, not as a search filter; production carries the warning tone only on the chip dot/text, never on shell chrome (amber shell chrome is reserved for staff).
From Proposal 1: the single shell-owned aria-live=polite status region announces once per switch ('Switched to Globex') and focus then moves to the page h1.

spec.trigger_expanded: SidebarHeader > SidebarMenu > SidebarMenuItem > SidebarMenuButton size="lg" (h-12, w-full, p-2, rounded-md) rendered with render={<PopoverTrigger />} (shadcn v4 / Base UI). Left: 32x32 rounded-md org avatar — logo, else two-letter initials (first letters of the first two words) on a hue derived deterministically from the org id. Middle, two truncated lines (~168px): line 1 org name text-sm font-medium truncate with title=full name; line 2 text-xs text-muted-foreground showing the normalised latchkey role for THIS org ('Owner' / 'Admin' / 'Member' / 'Viewer'). Right: ChevronsUpDown 16px, rendered only when memberships.length > 1 || invitations > 0 || canCreate || isStaff. Pending invitations: 16px count Badge (bg-primary text-[10px], min-w-4) overlapping the avatar's top-right corner. Staff view-as (from the session `act` claim): button gets bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950 and ring-2 ring-amber-500, line 2 becomes 'Staff view · not a member' in text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 with a 12px Eye icon, avatar keeps the ring. Attributes: type=button, aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded, aria-controls="org-switcher", aria-label rebuilt from data — 'Organisation: Acme Corp. Your role: Owner. 2 pending invitations. Switch organisation' — identical in both sidebar states; aria-busy plus a spinner overlay on the avatar while a switch is in flight. Before the session resolves the slot renders SidebarMenuSkeleton showIcon at the same 48px height (no layout shift); trigger disabled until memberships arrive. Single-org users with no invitations and no create capability get identity only: same row, no chevron, no popover, no aria-haspopup; chords unregistered. Identity (user avatar, email, account settings, invitations page link, sign-out) lives only in the footer NavUser, never here.
spec.trigger_rail: collapsible="icon" (48px): shadcn collapses the lg button to size-8 p-0 so only the 32px avatar shows; the invite count badge shrinks to an 8px dot on the avatar corner; the staff ring stays (ring-2 ring-amber-500 ring-offset-1). `tooltip` prop renders TooltipContent side="right" only when state === "collapsed" and not mobile: 'Acme Corp · Owner  G O' (staff: 'Acme Corp · Staff view'). Tooltip opens on Tab focus without delay, closes on Enter/Space/Esc, and is suppressed while the popover is open so two right-anchored surfaces never stack. The aria-label carries name + role + invite count so nothing depends on the tooltip (touch has none). The org name is deliberately repeated as crumb 1 in the action bar so it remains visible in the rail. Below 768px the sidebar becomes a Sheet and the switcher opens as a bottom Drawer with identical content, tooltips off, badge preserved.
menu_sections: POPOVER SHELL: shadcn Popover (never DropdownMenu) wrapping a cmdk Command; PopoverContent id="org-switcher" role="dialog" aria-label="Switch organisation", w-72 (288px), p-0, max-h-[70vh]; side="bottom" align="start" sideOffset={4} from the expanded header, side="right" align="start" sideOffset={8} from the 48px rail; bottom Drawer below 768px.

1. HEADER ROW (56px, non-interactive, outside the listbox): 32px avatar, org name font-medium truncate, role as Badge variant="secondary" ('Owner'), trailing Check 16px; a Settings icon button on the right ('Organisation settings', owner/admin only). In staff view-as the row is amber with Badge variant="outline" 'Staff view' and the button becomes 'Exit staff view'.

2. COMMAND INPUT (36px, border-b, always rendered, autofocused): placeholder 'Find organisation…', trailing CommandShortcut 'G O'; role=combobox with aria-controls/aria-activedescendant; the current org is the initially highlighted option so Enter on an empty query is a no-op and screen readers hear the current org first. Client-side filtering over the session-embedded memberships (cap 500); staff additionally get shouldFilter={false} plus a 250ms-debounced server query on ≥2 characters, stale requests aborted. Above 50 memberships a muted hint 'Type to search 212 organisations' shows until the query is non-empty and only Recent + first 8 rows render; rows virtualised above 100 (fixed 36px, aria-setsize/aria-posinset). A Combobox.Status-style aria-live line reports 'N results'.

3. INVITATIONS (n) — only when n > 0, first group: row 40px = 20px avatar, org name, secondary 'Invited by jane@acme.com as Admin', trailing ArrowRight; each is ONE role=option that navigates to /invitations/:id (Accept/Decline are real buttons on that page; interactive children are not allowed inside options).

4. RECENT — only when memberships > 8: last 3 visited, most recent first, stored server-side per user+console with localStorage fallback (key latchkey.recentOrgs.<userId>.<console>), pruned on every memberships refetch; same row anatomy as group 5.

5. YOUR ORGANISATIONS (heading shows total count): one row per active membership, current org pinned first with trailing Check and aria-selected=true, remainder alphabetical; row 36px = 20px avatar, name truncate (line-clamp-1, title=full), role in text-xs text-muted-foreground right-aligned. Suspended/deactivated memberships go to a separate INACTIVE group: dimmed, aria-disabled, Info icon whose tooltip carries the status name; not selectable (owners land on billing via the org's suspended page instead).

6. PLATFORM — platform staff only: 'All organisations…' (Building2 icon) → /platform/orgs full-page directory; while the query is ≥2 chars, server results for non-member orgs render here with an Eye icon, slug as secondary text and 'Not a member' instead of a role, so 'org I belong to' and 'org I can look into' are never confused.

7. SEPARATOR then ACTIONS group (no heading): while acting as staff, 'Exit staff view' first; 'Create organisation' (Plus) only when session capabilities include org:create → /orgs/new (a page, not a modal — creation has more than one field); for single-org users who still get a popover (invitations or create) the group also shows 'Invitations (0)' greyed so the path to a second org is never hidden.

8. STATES: CommandEmpty 'No organisations match “<query>”'; a distinct 'Couldn't load organisations — Retry' selectable row on fetch failure; Command.Loading = 3 skeleton rows (36px) with aria-busy, shown only after 1s (Primer loading rule), one announcement 'Loading organisations'; the popover never collapses to zero height. Nothing about the person (email, sign-out) lives in this menu.

SELECTION: POST /api/session/org {org} first (inline error and no navigation if refused); then client-navigate — if the current route's meta is scope:'org' the path is rewritten in place with the new slug, otherwise land on /o/:newSlug; every react-query key prefixed with the old slug is removed, per-console sub-scope stores reset, the env chip cleared; one polite live-region message 'Switched to Acme Corp'; focus moves to the new page's h1; the old page stays mounted until the new org's bootstrap query resolves.
spec.scope_levels: ORG — the sidebar-header trigger and the first path segment, /o/:orgSlug/…, in all three consoles; the URL is the source of truth (shareable links, two tabs on two orgs never clobber each other). The session's last-visited org (server-side per user+console, localStorage fallback) plus an account-level default org only decide where '/' and the '~' placeholder redirect; the default is auto-reassigned when membership is removed. A URL naming an org the user is not in renders a dedicated 403 page 'You are not a member of Acme Corp' with the switcher still mounted (staff see a 'View as staff' button there); never a silent fallback to the first org. CONTAINER SUB-SCOPE — tripline project, runsheet team/service, latchkey tenant — is a path segment and a switchable crumb in the sticky page action bar, left of the page breadcrumbs, 32px tall: crumb 1 is the org name as a muted Link to /o/:org (a link, not a second org control); crumb 2 is a Link to the scope's home plus a 24px chevron button (aria-haspopup="dialog") opening the same ScopePicker component (Popover+Command, search, current item checked, Recent group, 'Create …' footer gated by role). Latchkey tenant rows and crumb carry an environment tag badge (Prod/Staging, Google Cloud style). Sub-scope crumbs are hidden on org-level routes (settings, members, billing). FILTER SUB-SCOPE — tripline environment only — is a query param, ?env=production (absent = all), rendered as a chip right of the crumbs behind a 1px divider: h-8 outline button 'Env: production' with a 6px colour dot (production = amber-500 text-amber-700, staging = sky, dev = neutral); switching env or project preserves the current page ('projects as filters'). Per-console last-visited sub-scope is remembered per org server-side (user+console+org) so returning to an org restores its project/team/tenant; switching org never carries a sub-scope across. Deep links may use the placeholder (/o/:org/p/~/issues) which resolves to the remembered sub-scope or a chooser page. All API calls carry the org slug in the path; nothing except the '/' and '~' redirects depends on a server-side 'current org'. Below 768px the crumbs and chip collapse into one compound 'Acme / api-gateway / production ▾' button opening a Sheet with stacked pickers; the collapse rule is also tested at 1024–1280px so the action bar's own actions never wrap.
spec.staff_mode: Platform staff hold roles:["platform:staff"] in the latchkey session — a claim, not a membership. Their switcher lists only real memberships under 'Your organisations' plus the 'Platform' group (directory link + server search results marked 'Not a member'). /platform/orgs is a full-page DataTable directory: search by name/slug/owner email, status filter, Recent chip row (last 5, server-side) and Starred, a grey 'Current' badge on the row of the org they are already in, and a per-row 'View as staff' button. Entering an org they do not belong to (from a search result, the directory row, or the 403 page) opens a Dialog 'View Acme Corp as staff' with a required Reason textarea (min 10 chars) and Duration select (30 min / 1 h / 4 h, default 1 h); confirming calls POST /api/platform/view-as {org, reason, ttl}, which mints a session with act:{sub, org, reason, exp}, writes an audit event visible to that org's owners under Settings > Access log, then does a FULL RELOAD into /o/:slug so no prior tenant data survives in memory. All three consoles render the view-as chrome from the act claim: (a) sidebar-header trigger amber with 'Staff view · not a member' and Eye icon, amber ring on the rail avatar; (b) a 32px sticky strip directly above the page action bar, full content width, bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950 border-b border-amber-300, role="status", reading 'Viewing Acme Corp as latchkey staff — read-only · expires in 47 min' with 'Elevate' and 'Exit' buttons on the right; not dismissible, not draggable; (c) <html data-staff-view> and a 3px amber top border on the sidebar so the state is visible while content scrolls; (d) document.title prefixed '[Staff] '. Read-only by default: every mutating control renders disabled with the tooltip 'Read-only in staff view — elevate to change', and a shared fetch wrapper refuses non-GET requests without an elevation token while act is present; the API independently rejects writes. 'Elevate' opens a second Dialog requiring step-up via latchkey (passkey if enrolled, otherwise emailed code), a reason, and a duration capped at 1 h; while elevated the strip turns bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-950 reading 'Elevated · can modify Acme Corp · 52 min left' with 'Drop elevation', and the org's owners are notified. 'Exit' (also Esc while the strip has focus, and 'Exit staff view' in the popover header and actions group) clears the act claim server-side and full-reloads to /platform/orgs; expiry does the same with a toast, and an expired flag mid-page shows the 403 page with 'View as staff' again. The flag is per session, so a second tab inherits the same chrome. Staff who are genuine members of an org see it exactly as any member would — real role, no amber — so amber chrome always means exactly 'not a member'. Amber is reserved for staff state; tripline's production colour lives only on the env chip.
spec.keyboard: Trigger: Tab reaches it first in the sidebar; Enter, Space or ArrowDown open the popover and place focus in the CommandInput with the current org highlighted. Global chords (750ms window, ignored when focus is in input/textarea/contenteditable, a Monaco/CodeMirror surface, or an open dialog; the guard ships in the shell hotkey hook and is tested against runsheet's editors): 'G then O' opens the org switcher from anywhere (shown in the rail tooltip, the input's CommandShortcut, and the trigger title); 'G then P' opens the container sub-scope picker (project / team / tenant) even when the crumbs are collapsed; 'G then E' opens the environment chip (tripline). The ⌘/Ctrl+K palette carries 'Switch organisation…', 'Switch project/team/tenant…' and 'Switch environment…' entries that open the same pickers with the typed query carried over. No positional ⌘/Ctrl+1–9 (browser tab shortcuts); no digit shortcuts inside the popover. Sidebar collapse stays on ⌘/Ctrl+B and the switcher works identically from the rail. Inside the popover: typing filters; ArrowUp/ArrowDown move aria-activedescendant across groups (headings skipped); Home/End jump; Enter selects; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger (onCloseAutoFocus / finalFocus); Tab cycles input → header settings/Exit button → footer actions → back (trapped); Backspace on an empty query does nothing. After a selection focus returns to the trigger and the route change moves it to the new page's h1 following the single 'Switched to …' announcement. Sub-scope pickers and the env chip use the same ScopePicker component and identical keys. In the staff strip Tab reaches Elevate then Exit; Esc on the strip triggers Exit. Chord hints are hidden and the chevron removed for users with exactly one org; a shortcuts page lists G O / G P / G E.
spec.edge_cases: ZERO ORGS: no sidebar, no action bar; full-page /welcome with pending invitations as cards with real Accept/Decline buttons, a 'Create organisation' card if org:create, otherwise 'Ask an organisation admin to invite you with <email>' with a copy button; staff with zero memberships land on /platform/orgs. ONE ORG: identity-only trigger (no chevron, no chord hint); if invitations, create or staff apply, the popover still opens with header + 'Invitations (n)' + actions so a second org is reachable; NavUser also links to Invitations and Create. 50+ ORGS / STAFF: input always present, 'Type to search N organisations' hint, Recent group, virtualised rows above 100, staff server search debounced 250ms with abort-on-stale and Command.Loading, and the full-page directory for browsing; memberships still arrive embedded in /session (cap 500) so the popover opens instantly. PENDING INVITATIONS: count badge on the avatar in both sidebar states (dot in the rail); 'Invitations (n)' is the first group; each item navigates to /invitations/:id; accepting invalidates memberships, adds the org to recents and lands on its home with a toast; an invite link opened from email while signed in deep-links straight to /invitations/:id (with an explicit return-to param if consoles are on different origins); an invitation to an org the user already belongs to is auto-consumed; declined/expired invites leave the badge within the session. LONG NAMES: trigger line truncates with title=; popover rows line-clamp-1 with title=; crumbs truncate at 160px each and the action bar drops the org link first when width is short; initials use the first two words; staff results add the slug. LOADING: SidebarMenuSkeleton at 48px until /session resolves; nothing extra under 1s, then skeleton rows with one aria-busy group; fetch failure shows the Retry row, never an empty list; during a switch the trigger is aria-busy with a spinner overlay, a 2px indeterminate Progress bar sits under the action bar, and the old page stays mounted until the new bootstrap resolves. SUSPENDED ORG: listed in 'Inactive', disabled, status tooltip; its URL renders a full-page 'Acme Corp is suspended' state with the switcher intact (owners get a billing link). NOT A MEMBER URL: the 403 page described under scopes; staff see 'View as staff'. STAFF EXPIRY: strip counts down, expiry toasts and reloads to /platform/orgs; a stale act claim on any request returns the 403 page. MOBILE (<768px): sidebar as Sheet, switcher as bottom Drawer, crumbs+chip as one compound button opening a Sheet, tooltips disabled. MULTI-TAB: org in the path so tabs never clobber; view-as is per session so tabs agree on chrome. INITIALS COLLISIONS in the rail are mitigated by the aria-label, tooltip and crumb 1 in the action bar.
spec.aria: Trigger: <button> with aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded, aria-controls="org-switcher", aria-label rebuilt from data ('Organisation: Acme Corp. Your role: Owner. 2 pending invitations. Switch organisation'), aria-busy during a switch; identity-only variant drops aria-haspopup and the chevron. Popover: PopoverContent role="dialog" aria-label="Switch organisation" (Base UI/Radix popover semantics; the header row and action buttons are ordinary focusables inside the dialog). Command: input role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls=<listbox id> aria-activedescendant=<active option id> aria-autocomplete="list"; list role="listbox"; each CommandGroup role="group" aria-labelledby=<heading id>; rows role="option" with aria-selected="true" only on the current org, aria-disabled="true" on inactive memberships, aria-setsize/aria-posinset set manually when virtualised; a visually-hidden aria-live="polite" status line reports result counts ('12 results', 'Searching…'). Live regions: exactly one shell-owned aria-live="polite" status region announces 'Loading organisations' (once, after 1s) and 'Switched to <org>' (once per switch, never per store reset); aria-busy is set on the loading group, not on the live region, so a stuck load cannot silence it. Tooltip: rendered only when the sidebar is collapsed and not mobile, with content matching the trigger's aria-label prefix, opens on focus without delay, closes on Enter/Space/Esc, suppressed while the popover is open. Staff strip: role="status" with the countdown text; Elevate/Exit are <button>s; <html data-staff-view> and document.title '[Staff] ' prefix. Sub-scope crumbs: the name is an <a>, the chevron is a <button aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="Switch project">; the env chip is a <button aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="Environment: production. Change environment">. Focus: Esc and selection return focus to the trigger (onCloseAutoFocus / finalFocus), then the shell's route-focus rule moves focus to the new page's h1. Invitation rows are single options (no nested interactive children); Accept/Decline live on /invitations/:id.
spec.url: All consoles: /o/:orgSlug/… (org is the first segment after the console root; the URL is the source of truth). Placeholder: /o/~/… resolves to last-visited org for this console → account default org → first membership, then rewrites the URL. Tripline: /o/:org/p/:project/issues?env=production (project is a path container, environment a query filter; absent env = all; /o/:org/p/~/issues resolves the remembered project). Runsheet: /o/:org/t/:teamOrService/runbooks (teams and services share one picker with a type icon). Latchkey admin: /o/:org/tenants/:tenant/users; org-level pages /o/:org/settings, /o/:org/members, /o/:org/billing, /o/:org/settings/access-log. Cross-org pages: /welcome (zero-org gate), /invitations/:id (accept/decline page; invite emails deep-link here), /orgs/new (create org). Staff: /platform/orgs (directory), POST /api/platform/view-as, POST /api/session/org (switch, called before navigation). Route meta: every route declares scope: 'org' | 'project' | 'team' | 'tenant' (lint-enforced); org switches rewrite in place only for scope:'org' routes and otherwise land on /o/:newSlug.

alternatives.name: Rail-anchored command switcher (Proposal 1)
alternatives.when_to_prefer: When switching frequency dominates and staff access is low-stakes: an internal-only deployment where platform staff are the same small team as the tenants' admins, no PII-bearing tenant lists, and developers hop between orgs dozens of times a day. Its free read-only staff browsing, recents-first popover and O-then-1..3 direct-switch chords are faster than a reason dialog per visit; take it if you can accept positional shortcuts that shift as recents change and a staff model that records writes but not views.

alternatives.name: Root Crumb: query-param filter chips (Proposal 3)
alternatives.when_to_prefer: When every sub-scope in every console really is a filter — multi-select projects, 'all teams', tenant-as-filter over a shared user list — and none of them grows its own sub-navigation. Then Sentry's model (org in the rail, everything else as ?param chips persisted per org) gives the smallest shell, one route shape, and page-preserving switches everywhere; also the right call if you want to defer the staff elevation flow entirely and ship only a fixed-TTL read-only view-as.

alternatives.name: Plain DropdownMenu with menuitemradio (shadcn sidebar-07 as shipped)
alternatives.when_to_prefer: If the product caps memberships at a handful per user, invitations are handled by email only, and staff never enter tenants from the switcher (they use the /platform/orgs directory exclusively). The APG menu-button model is lighter, needs no search state, and announces the current org natively via aria-checked; it stops working past ~15–20 orgs or the moment you need a search field or an invitation row with actions.
